newsitem.title: UK: JAPANESE STOCKS UP IN LONDON ON BARGAIN HUNTING.
newsitem.headline: JAPANESE STOCKS UP IN LONDON ON BARGAIN HUNTING.

text.p: Japanese stocks were firmer in London as investors sifted through the high-tech sector for bargains, dealers said.
The Nikkei index was up 3.17 points to 1,650.80 at 1408 GMT.
In Tokyo, the benchmark Nikkei 225 index rose 274.93 points to 19,099.11, after tumbling nearly four percent in the previous session.
"Volume is thin. People have been completely spooked by what's happened in Tokyo," one dealer said.
He said high-tech stocks were attracting the most interest. Shares in Fujitsu Ltd were trading about 10 yen above their close in Tokyo.

Bank shares also drew investor interest, he said. Shares in Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd gained about 15 yen from their Tokyo closing level, while shares in Fuji Bank Ltd added about 20 yen. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
